answer: Each epoch, 5% of identities are cross-examined: random peers quiz you 10 minutes on your work, answers etched on the karst. A borrowed answer earns a violet flag; two flags freeze it, burning its 40-credit bond. A rented stand-in for many names leaves matching timing and betrays the ring. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 stand-ins on call, 60 each, 60,000 against a 40,000-credit nectar pool. Honest agents answer from memory, pay nothing, keep full share.
